title: Pigeon
description: One bird, one city, one natural weapon. Fly Kevin home across five districts, drop payloads on first dates, joggers, taxis and clean laundry for combos and captions, spare your own flock, and dodge the falcon whose sandwich you ate.
controls: Tap, click or Space: flap. Hold: drop (Down/S/X drops at once). The ring on the ground shows where it lands. P pauses, M mutes, R restarts, Esc returns to the menu.
